item.title: More diesel relief for farmers
item.description: From 1 April, farmers will be able to claim more under the Diesel Refund Scheme, thanks to the government’s decision to make 100% of qualifying diesel consumption eligible for the scheme going forward. Currently, farmers can reclaim 80% of their qualifying consumption.

item.title: German mission scouts Eastern Cape’s seafood export potential
item.description: A promising partnership between Germany and South Africa’s Eastern Cape is taking shape as European buyers set their sights on the province’s untapped seafood export potential. Last week, a German delegation concluded a comprehensive sourcing mission that could open new pathways for local fishing communities to access lucrative European markets.

item.title: China deal encouraging, but tariff reform must continue
item.description: Tru-Cape has welcomed the signing of the CAEPA agreement between the Department of Trade, Industry and Competition and China, which will provide zero-tariff access for South African apples and pears from 1 May 2026.

item.title: How Langa is turning food waste into a valuable resource
item.description: In Langa in Cape Town, an approach to waste management is quietly changing how an entire community thinks about food scraps. What was once destined for distant landfills is now being transformed into valuable compost, creating jobs and supporting local food security in the process.

item.title: 19th Hencil Dohne Merino production auction offers quality
item.description: Vleissentraal hosted an excellent production auction on 28 January on behalf of Henro and Cecil van der Merwe’s Hencil–Dohne–Merino stud on the farm Grootvlei in the Barkly East district.

item.title: WATCH | Here’s how the FMD vaccines will be rolled out
item.description: Agriculture Minister John Steenhuisen couldn’t hide his elation at OR Tambo International Airport on Saturday as he received what he described as the “single largest veterinary vaccine import to South Africa at one time”, referring to the one million doses of high-potency foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine from Argentinian company Biogenesis Bago.

item.title: Joy as hardest hit KZN gets 200k doses of FMD vaccine
item.description: KwaZulu-Natal’s MEC for Agriculture and Rural Development, Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa, has expressed joy upon the arrival of one million foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccines from Biogénesis Bagó in Argentina. The much-needed vaccines arrived at the OR Tambo International Airport on Saturday and were officially received by the Department of Agriculture Minister John Steenhuisen.

item.title: Sihlobo expresses gratitude following presidential envoy appointment
item.description: Wandile Sihlobo, Chief Economist of the Agricultural Business Chamber of South Africa (Agbiz), has expressed his appreciation for the support he has received following his appointment as Presidential Envoy on Agriculture and Land.
